answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. One chip, one identity: the attestation quote is checked at registration and re-checked every 10 epochs, and a quote reused across keys burns both seats. Buying 460 chips for 460 fakes costs more than the farm could ever earn back. Re-verification is public, so anyone can challenge a stale quote. The vault of the design is public, the atlas of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the yarrow of honest work is what finally pays. Pay the price once, or pay it a thousand times — the farm chooses.
